findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "palanor_get_signal" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.palanor.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: palanor_get_form_d_offerings, palanor_get_form_d_issuer, palanor_insider_transactions, palanor_get_embed_code, palanor_get_chart, palanor_list_screens, palanor_search_documents · Private data: palanor_get_signal, palanor_get_form_d_offerings, palanor_get_advisers, palanor_get_adviser, palanor_get_private_funds, palanor_get_private_fund_stats, palanor_get_deals, palanor_fails_to_deliver, palanor_release_calendar, palanor_get_industry, palanor_tracker, palanor_create_chart, palanor_search_documents · Public sink: palanor_get_guidance, palanor_get_ai_venture_share, palanor_get_private_fund_stats, palanor_fails_to_deliver, palanor_company_patents, palanor_congress_holdings, palanor_release_calendar, palanor_get_world_share_prices, palanor_get_embed_code · Destructive: palanor_list_screens, palanor_run_screen.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
